parsed.why: No facility ban, bath-room law repealed 2017, no violence record; but no statewide hate-crime or public-accommodations coverage, narrowing document rules, and the national passport/custody regime applies unchanged.

Flagged moderate-risk tier with negative rules advancing via appointed boards; no adult facility ban, yet statewide nondiscrimination and hate-crime gaps leave visitors without recourse beyond four municipalities.

Police themselves describe epidemic-level lethal violence against trans women with multiple recent shootings, plus adult surgical access withdrawn; no protective tier or remedy documented, adding local exposure to the national regime.

Low-risk tier, governor vetoed bathroom bills, employment and nine-city accommodation protections, marker changes available; offset by trans-panic defence, youth-only targeting and Pride collapse signalling a chilling climate.

Top protective-law band, sanctuary care law and identity-based prison housing; but highest raw incident count, rising city hate-crime reports and officials platforming anti-trans figures show hostility coexisting with protections.
